executive_summary: Episode centers on 'cameragate' – post-shooting footage of two unidentified men at the scene, with one removing a camera and apparent SD/SIM card. Host claims personal contact with the camera-handler and FaceTime viewing of behind-shot footage showing no blood. Threads: Senate resolution for Charlie Kirk Remembrance Day, Pam Bondi hate-speech remarks, Jimmy Kimmel suspension and FCC threat, alleged Israel-linked media campaign against Owens, and TPUSA financial apparatus investigation.

claims.label: Host Says Two Men Moved Charlie's Chair and Removed Camera Post-Shooting
claims.claim: The host says footage she shows has two men appearing in the immediate aftermath of the shooting, one of whom moves Charlie Kirk's chair and takes down the camera above his head.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify both individuals via facial recognition, witness statements, and cross-reference against footage metadata.
claims.transcript_snippet: that same individual appears alongside another individual and he moves Charlie's chair

claims.label: Host Says Individual Calmly Talked on Phone Near Car After Shooting
claims.claim: The host says footage she shows has an individual standing near the car where Charlie was taken, appearing to calmly talk into his phone shortly after the shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full-resolution copy of wide-angle clip; cross-reference timing against crowd movement logs.
claims.transcript_snippet: that person appears to be calmly talking into their phone. It's like a circus around them

claims.label: Host Says Camera Individual Appeared to Remove SD/SIM Card
claims.claim: The host says the footage she shows has the individual handling the camera appearing to remove the SD or SIM card after setting the camera on the desk.
claims.investigative_direction: Forensically examine the recovered camera for evidence of card removal and identify any cards removed.
claims.transcript_snippet: it looks like he removes the SIM card from it or the SD card if you will

claims.label: Host Says Camera Individual Has Been Around TPUSA for Years
claims.claim: The host says the individual who handled the camera has been around Turning Point USA for years, going back to her own early days working there.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify association via TPUSA employee/vendor records and corroborate timeline with other witnesses.
claims.transcript_snippet: This person's been around Turning Point for quite some time, for years

claims.label: Host Says Behind-Shot Footage Shown to Her Contained No Blood
claims.claim: The host says the footage shown to her via FaceTime from the rear angle showed no blood or gore.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying behind-shot footage directly and have independent forensic analysts review it.
claims.transcript_snippet: there's no blood... there's no blood from the back
claims.uncertainty_note: Footage itself not shown in episode; claim rests on host's account of FaceTime viewing.

claims.label: Host Says Senate Passed Bipartisan Kirk Remembrance Day Resolution
claims.claim: The host says the U.S. Senate has voted and passed a bipartisan resolution designating October 14, Charlie Kirk's birthday, as Charlie Kirk Remembrance Day.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the resolution text in the Congressional Record and verify vote tally.
claims.transcript_snippet: the Senate has voted and they have passed a bipartisan resolution to designate October 14th

claims.label: Daily Mail published snub-rage headline about Candace
claims.claim: The Daily Mail ran a headline written by Victoria Churchill stating Candace Owens rages after being snubbed from the Charlie Kirk Memorial speaking roster.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify headline and byline on the Daily Mail site and check publication date.
claims.transcript_snippet: Candace Owens rages after being snubbed from the Charlie Kirk Memorial speaking roster

claims.label: PBD Guest Said Candace's Credibility Is Going Down the Tubes
claims.claim: In a PBD podcast clip the host plays, a guest, Eric Bolling, says Candace Owens' credibility is going to go "down the tubes" because she needs to bring receipts, and a speaker in the clip adds that Bill Ackman brought receipts.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full PBD segment and verify exact quote against published clip.
claims.transcript_snippet: her credibility, I mean, is going to go down the tubes because she needs to bring receipts

claims.label: The "bring receipts" line C-1212 attributes to Bill Ackman is the PBD guest's; the guest cites Bill Ackman as having brought receipts
claims.claim: In the PBD clip the host replays at 00:25:42–00:25:55, the line that Candace Owens' credibility is going "down the tubes because she needs to bring receipts" is spoken by the PBD guest, Eric Bolling, who goes straight on to say Bill Ackman "brought receipts" and refers to him in the third person ("I think he was there in the room"). Bill Ackman is cited in the clip, not speaking, so C-1212's attribution of the line to "Bill Ackman" (Bill Ackman, N-37) is contradicted.
claims.investigative_direction: Read with C-1212; identify the PBD guest from the full segment.
claims.transcript_snippet: Bill Ackman brought receipts. How long was that tweet? It's still going. I think he was there in the room.
claims.uncertainty_note: The transcript does not mark speaker turns and the guest is not named in this clip; the attribution rests on the guest's third-person reference to Ackman.

claims.label: PBD Guest Said He Last Saw Candace at TPUSA in 2015 or 2016
